verdicts.reason: A breaks the SALE lockup: the letters are pulled out of their circles and reordered so the canvas reads 'E / NEW YEAR SPECIAL / S A L'. The empty white circles are shrunk to a tiny stack at the bottom, and a large dead band sits under the art, so the core message is unreadable. B gets the reading order right, with the headline at top and SALE kept in its circles, but the circles crowd into each other. The letters inside are mis-sized and off-centre (A and L tiny, S and E large and offset), the decorative cluster is duplicated in two stacked copies, and the headline is cramped against the top edge.
